disclosure.claims: Enforced: AC-1 and AC-3 outcomes exactly as stated in the src/backfill.ts docstring and BACKFILL_HELP. Declared residual (ADR-0013 (c)): a relocation of a write directory that takes effect only inside the interval between the run's final verification and its kernel write, and that is undone again before the run next verifies, is not observed; the run is not required to detect or defeat that interval; the removals and restorations of AC-1 are best-effort controls, not guarantees, and are not claimed to be single kernel operations. ADR-0013 is not edited. The "deferred" wording of the prior todo legs and docstrings (the residual presented as deferred to the ADR-0013 review) no longer appears under src/ or test/. Pre-existing text disclosed, not written by this goal: the test name at test/evolve-layout.test.ts:403 is phrased as an absolute about writes through a symlinked evolve/ and is an unchanged (a)-class regression case in a scope file this goal does not modify (disclosed, not rewritten); the ACH-C-04 criterion quoted in the test/backfill.test.ts header is that goal's registered wording and is annotated, not repeated as a claim.
disclosure.codes: Exactly two observable result codes added: path_relocated and root_not_canonical. The 21 code: literals present at base (invalid, inventory_invalid, inventory_refused, inventory_unattributable, ledger_append_failed, path_changed, path_multiply_linked, path_not_directory, path_not_regular_file, path_symlinked, plan_in_flight, policy_unsupported, policy_v2_differs, root_missing, root_not_directory, root_symlinked, template_missing, template_unresolved_token, template_unsupported, unavailable, unreachable) remain with their meanings; path_changed is now raised when the ledger entry stops naming the opened descriptor before the write (its base meaning), through the opt-in requireEntryIdentity option of the containment primitives. The five evolve refusal kinds are unchanged; containment refusals additionally carry an optional reason/subject discriminator (src/evolve/errors.ts) that backfill maps without matching message text.
disclosure.component_mapping: A validated component observed moved, replaced, removed or turned into a symlink after its identity was recorded - the root chain (recorded by inspectRoot) and the entered .ai, .ai/policies or .ai/drift directories - is path_relocated naming the component. A symlink or non-directory found at descent, before that component identity is recorded (the pathname pre-walk validates type, not identity), keeps the existing (a)-class codes path_symlinked / path_not_directory, consistent with the inventory-time invalidation fixture.
disclosure.scope_note: All edits are inside the six scope paths: src/backfill.ts, src/evolve/containment.ts, src/evolve/errors.ts, test/backfill.test.ts and this file; test/evolve-layout.test.ts is in scope but unchanged (its 38 cases are the regression battery and pass with unchanged assertions). .ai/ci/local-ci.json pins none of the scope paths and is untouched.

Red leg: T1-T7 (T3b included) written first and run against the base implementation with one identical command; they fail there behaviourally - T1, T3, T3b: exit 0 and result written with the policy landed in the relocated directory outside the root; T6: exit 0 and result written (the ancestor-of-root symlink adopted by realpath); T2, T4, T5: result failed with code path_symlinked instead of path_relocated and an empty ledger created outside the root; T7: exit 1 with no structured report (an unexpected ENOENT from the pathname rename). T9 is the ADR-0013 (c) conformance fixture: it passes at base with the same outcome (exit 0, result written, policy inside the root) and is not claimed red. Green: the identical command exits 0 at the final head with all nine fixtures passing.
